#MODEL MULTINOMIAL (MODEL DE REFERÈNCIA)

```{r}

# 0) PREPARACIÓ
setwd("~/Desktop/DADES")
load("EPA_2005_2025v2.RData")
rm(list = setdiff(ls(), "EPA_2005_2025v2"))

library(data.table)
library(nnet)

setDT(EPA_2005_2025v2)


# 1) FUNCIÓ PER COMPROVAR SI ANY ÉS VÀLID

es_any_valid <- function(x) {
  x <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(x))
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) return(FALSE)
  anys_uniques <- sort(unique(x))
  cond1 <- min(anys_uniques) <= 2005
  cond2 <- max(anys_uniques) >= 2025
  cond3 <- length(anys_uniques) >= 10
  cond1 && cond2 && cond3
}


# 2) ANY: PRIORITZAR EL QUE JA EXISTEIX SI ÉS BO

if ("ANY" %in% names(EPA_2005_2025v2) && es_any_valid(EPA_2005_2025v2$ANY)) {
  
  EPA_2005_2025v2[, ANY := as.integer(ANY)]
  cat("\nS'utilitza la variable ANY ja existent.\n")
  
} else {
  
  cat("\nANY no existeix o no és coherent. S'intenta reconstruir a partir de CICLO.\n")
  
  if (!"CICLO" %in% names(EPA_2005_2025v2)) {
    stop("No existeix ANY vàlida i tampoc existeix CICLO per reconstruir-la.")
  }
  
  EPA_2005_2025v2[, ciclo_num := suppressWarnings(as.integer(as.character(CICLO)))]
  
  EPA_2005_2025v2[, ANY := fifelse(
    !is.na(ciclo_num),
    2005L + (ciclo_num - 130L) %/% 4L,
    NA_integer_
  )]
}

cat("\n====================\n")
cat("RANG D'ANYS A LA BASE\n")
print(range(EPA_2005_2025v2$ANY, na.rm = TRUE))

cat("\nDISTRIBUCIÓ PER ANY (ABANS DE FILTRES)\n")
print(EPA_2005_2025v2[, .N, by = ANY][order(ANY)])


# 3) FUNCIÓ AUXILIAR: APROXIMAR EDAT A PARTIR D'EDAD5

aprox_edat_edad5 <- function(x) {
  x <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(x)))
  fcase(
    x == 16, 17.5,
    x == 20, 22.0,
    x == 25, 27.0,
    x == 30, 32.0,
    x == 35, 37.0,
    x == 40, 42.0,
    x == 45, 47.0,
    x == 50, 52.0,
    x == 55, 57.0,
    x == 60, 62.0,
    x >= 65, 67.0,
    default = NA_real_
  )
}


# 4) FUNCIÓ AUXILIAR: APROXIMAR EDAT A PARTIR DE GRUPS

aprox_edat_grup <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(tolower(as.character(x)))
  
  fcase(
    x %in% c("16-29", "16-29 anys", "16 a 29 anys", "de 16 a 29 anys"), 22.5,
    x %in% c("30-44", "30-44 anys", "30 a 44 anys", "de 30 a 44 anys"), 37.0,
    x %in% c("45-59", "45-59 anys", "45 a 59 anys", "de 45 a 59 anys"), 52.0,
    x %in% c("60+", "60 o més", "60 o més anys", "60 i més", "60 i mes"), 67.0,
    default = NA_real_
  )
}


# 5) CONSTRUIR EDAT HARMONITZADA

EPA_2005_2025v2[, EDAT := NA_real_]

# 5.1 exacta: EDAT_NUM_1
if ("EDAT_NUM_1" %in% names(EPA_2005_2025v2)) {
  EPA_2005_2025v2[, EDAT_tmp := suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(EDAT_NUM_1)))]
  EPA_2005_2025v2[is.na(EDAT) & !is.na(EDAT_tmp) & EDAT_tmp >= 16 & EDAT_tmp <= 99, EDAT := EDAT_tmp]
  EPA_2005_2025v2[, EDAT_tmp := NULL]
}

# 5.2 exacta: EDAT_NUM_2
if ("EDAT_NUM_2" %in% names(EPA_2005_2025v2)) {
  EPA_2005_2025v2[, EDAT_tmp := suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(EDAT_NUM_2)))]
  EPA_2005_2025v2[is.na(EDAT) & !is.na(EDAT_tmp) & EDAT_tmp >= 16 & EDAT_tmp <= 99, EDAT := EDAT_tmp]
  EPA_2005_2025v2[, EDAT_tmp := NULL]
}

# 5.3 exacta: EDAD1
if ("EDAD1" %in% names(EPA_2005_2025v2)) {
  EPA_2005_2025v2[, EDAT_tmp := suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(EDAD1)))]
  EPA_2005_2025v2[is.na(EDAT) & !is.na(EDAT_tmp) & EDAT_tmp >= 16 & EDAT_tmp <= 99, EDAT := EDAT_tmp]
  EPA_2005_2025v2[, EDAT_tmp := NULL]
}

# 5.4 exacta: EDAT1
if ("EDAT1" %in% names(EPA_2005_2025v2)) {
  EPA_2005_2025v2[, EDAT_tmp := suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(EDAT1)))]
  EPA_2005_2025v2[is.na(EDAT) & !is.na(EDAT_tmp) & EDAT_tmp >= 16 & EDAT_tmp <= 99, EDAT := EDAT_tmp]
  EPA_2005_2025v2[, EDAT_tmp := NULL]
}

# 5.5 aproximada: EDAD5
if ("EDAD5" %in% names(EPA_2005_2025v2)) {
  EPA_2005_2025v2[is.na(EDAT), EDAT := aprox_edat_edad5(EDAD5)]
}

# 5.6 aproximada: GRUP_EDAT
if ("GRUP_EDAT" %in% names(EPA_2005_2025v2)) {
  EPA_2005_2025v2[is.na(EDAT), EDAT := aprox_edat_grup(GRUP_EDAT)]
}

# 5.7 aproximada: EDAT_TRAM
if ("EDAT_TRAM" %in% names(EPA_2005_2025v2)) {
  EPA_2005_2025v2[is.na(EDAT), EDAT := aprox_edat_grup(EDAT_TRAM)]
}

cat("\n====================\n")
cat("OBSERVACIONS AMB EDAT DISPONIBLE PER ANY\n")
print(EPA_2005_2025v2[!is.na(EDAT), .N, by = ANY][order(ANY)])


# 6) ORDRE EDUCATIU

ordre_nforma <- c("AN", "P1", "P2", "S1", "SG", "SP", "SU")


# 7) BASE INICIAL
#    només ocupats, 2005-2025, sense militars

base_multinom <- EPA_2005_2025v2[
  ANY >= 2005 & ANY <= 2025 &
    !is.na(AOI) &
    trimws(as.character(AOI)) != "" &
    sprintf("%02d", as.integer(AOI)) %in% c("03", "04") &
    !is.na(NFORMA) & trimws(as.character(NFORMA)) != "" &
    !is.na(OCUP1) & trimws(as.character(OCUP1)) != "" &
    trimws(as.character(OCUP1)) != "0" &
    !is.na(ANY) &
    !is.na(SEXO1) & trimws(as.character(SEXO1)) %in% c("1", "6") &
    !is.na(CCAA) & trimws(as.character(CCAA)) != "" &
    !is.na(EDAT) &
    !is.na(FACTOREL),
  .(
    ANY,
    NFORMA = trimws(as.character(NFORMA)),
    OCUP1 = trimws(as.character(OCUP1)),
    SEXO1 = trimws(as.character(SEXO1)),
    CCAA = sprintf("%02d", as.integer(CCAA)),
    EDAT,
    FACTOREL
  )
]

cat("\n====================\n")
cat("MOSTRA DESPRÉS DEL FILTRE PRINCIPAL\n")
cat("\nNombre d'observacions:\n")
print(nrow(base_multinom))

cat("\nDistribució per ANY després del filtre principal:\n")
print(base_multinom[, .N, by = ANY][order(ANY)])


# 8) MODA EDUCATIVA PER OCUPACIÓ (PONDERADA)

moda <- base_multinom[
  ,
  .(pes = sum(FACTOREL, na.rm = TRUE)),
  by = .(OCUP1, NFORMA)
]

moda[, NFORMA := factor(NFORMA, levels = ordre_nforma, ordered = TRUE)]

moda_final <- moda[
  order(OCUP1, -pes, NFORMA)
][
  , .SD[1], by = OCUP1
]

setnames(moda_final, "NFORMA", "NFORMA_MODA")


# 9) ASSIGNAR MODA

base_multinom[, NFORMA := factor(NFORMA, levels = ordre_nforma, ordered = TRUE)]

base_multinom <- merge(
  base_multinom,
  moda_final[, .(OCUP1, NFORMA_MODA)],
  by = "OCUP1",
  all.x = TRUE
)


# 10) VARIABLE DE DESAJUST

base_multinom[, DESAJUST := fcase(
  NFORMA < NFORMA_MODA, "Infraqualificacio",
  NFORMA == NFORMA_MODA, "Ajust",
  NFORMA > NFORMA_MODA, "Sobrequalificacio"
)]

base_multinom[, DESAJUST_f := factor(
  DESAJUST,
  levels = c("Ajust", "Infraqualificacio", "Sobrequalificacio")
)]

cat("\nDistribució del desajust:\n")
print(base_multinom[, .N, by = DESAJUST_f])


# 11) VARIABLES EXPLICATIVES

base_multinom[, dona := ifelse(SEXO1 == "6", 1, 0)]
base_multinom[, CCAA_f := factor(CCAA)]

base_multinom[, EDAT_c := EDAT - mean(EDAT, na.rm = TRUE)]
base_multinom[, EDAT_c2 := EDAT_c^2]


# 12) VARIABLE TEMPORAL FICTÍCIA PER BLOCS

base_multinom[, PERIODE_chr := fcase(
  ANY >= 2005 & ANY <= 2007, "Expansio_2005_2007",
  ANY >= 2008 & ANY <= 2013, "Crisi_2008_2013",
  ANY >= 2014 & ANY <= 2019, "Recuperacio_2014_2019",
  ANY >= 2020 & ANY <= 2025, "Pandemia_Post_2020_2025",
  default = NA_character_
)]

base_multinom <- base_multinom[!is.na(PERIODE_chr)]

base_multinom[, PERIODE_f := factor(PERIODE_chr)]
base_multinom[, PERIODE_f := droplevels(PERIODE_f)]

cat("\nDistribució per PERIODE_f:\n")
print(base_multinom[, .N, by = PERIODE_f][order(PERIODE_f)])

cat("\nDistribució per ANY i PERIODE_f:\n")
print(base_multinom[, .N, by = .(ANY, PERIODE_f)][order(ANY)])

if ("Recuperacio_2014_2019" %in% levels(base_multinom$PERIODE_f)) {
  base_multinom[, PERIODE_f := relevel(PERIODE_f, ref = "Recuperacio_2014_2019")]
} else {
  warning("La categoria Recuperacio_2014_2019 no existeix. Es manté la referència per defecte.")
}

base_multinom[, PERIODE_chr := NULL]


# 13) MOSTRA FINAL COMPLETA

base_multinom <- base_multinom[
  !is.na(DESAJUST_f) &
    !is.na(dona) &
    !is.na(EDAT_c) &
    !is.na(EDAT_c2) &
    !is.na(CCAA_f) &
    !is.na(PERIODE_f) &
    !is.na(FACTOREL)
]

base_multinom[, DESAJUST_f := droplevels(DESAJUST_f)]
base_multinom[, CCAA_f := droplevels(CCAA_f)]
base_multinom[, PERIODE_f := droplevels(PERIODE_f)]

cat("\n====================\n")
cat("MOSTRA FINAL DEL MODEL\n")
cat("\nNombre final d'observacions:\n")
print(nrow(base_multinom))

cat("\nNivells de DESAJUST_f:\n")
print(levels(base_multinom$DESAJUST_f))
print(base_multinom[, .N, by = DESAJUST_f])

cat("\nNombre de nivells de CCAA_f:\n")
print(length(levels(base_multinom$CCAA_f)))

cat("\nNivells de PERIODE_f:\n")
print(levels(base_multinom$PERIODE_f))
print(base_multinom[, .N, by = PERIODE_f])


# 14) COMPROVACIÓ FINAL

if (uniqueN(base_multinom$DESAJUST_f) < 2) {
  stop("DESAJUST_f només té 1 nivell després dels filtres.")
}

if (uniqueN(base_multinom$CCAA_f) < 2) {
  stop("CCAA_f només té 1 nivell després dels filtres.")
}

if (uniqueN(base_multinom$PERIODE_f) < 2) {
  stop("PERIODE_f només té 1 nivell després dels filtres.")
}


# 15) PESOS REESCALATS

base_multinom[, pes_reesc := FACTOREL / mean(FACTOREL, na.rm = TRUE)]


# 16) MODEL MULTINOMIAL DE REFERÈNCIA AMB PESOS

m_multinom_ref <- multinom(
  DESAJUST_f ~ dona + EDAT_c + EDAT_c2 + CCAA_f + PERIODE_f,
  data = base_multinom,
  weights = pes_reesc,
  Hess = TRUE,
  trace = FALSE,
  MaxNWts = 20000
)

# 17) SUMMARY

summary(m_multinom_ref)


# 18) AIC
cat("\nAIC del model:\n")
print(AIC(m_multinom_ref))


# 19) z I p-valors
resum_multinom_ref <- summary(m_multinom_ref)

coefs_ref <- resum_multinom_ref$coefficients
ses_ref   <- resum_multinom_ref$standard.errors

zvals_ref <- coefs_ref / ses_ref
pvals_ref <- 2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(zvals_ref)))

cat("\nCoeficients:\n")
print(coefs_ref)

cat("\nErrors estàndard:\n")
print(ses_ref)

cat("\nz-values:\n")
print(zvals_ref)

cat("\np-valors:\n")
print(pvals_ref)

# 20) TAULA NETA PER AL TFG

keep_terms <- c(
  "dona",
  "EDAT_c",
  "EDAT_c2",
  "PERIODE_fExpansio_2005_2007",
  "PERIODE_fCrisi_2008_2013",
  "PERIODE_fPandemia_Post_2020_2025"
)

labels <- c(
  "dona" = "Dona",
  "EDAT_c" = "Edat (centrada)",
  "EDAT_c2" = "Edat²",
  "PERIODE_fExpansio_2005_2007" = "Expansió (vs Recuperació)",
  "PERIODE_fCrisi_2008_2013" = "Crisi (vs Recuperació)",
  "PERIODE_fPandemia_Post_2020_2025" = "Pandèmia/post (vs Recuperació)"
)

extreure_taula_multinom <- function(model, keep_terms, labels, base_data) {
  
  s <- summary(model)
  coefs <- s$coefficients
  ses   <- s$standard.errors
  
  zvals <- coefs / ses
  pvals <- 2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(zvals)))
  
  res <- rbindlist(lapply(rownames(coefs), function(cat) {
    data.table(
      Comparacio = cat,
      Variable = colnames(coefs),
      Coef = as.numeric(coefs[cat, ]),
      SE = as.numeric(ses[cat, ]),
      z = as.numeric(zvals[cat, ]),
      p = as.numeric(pvals[cat, ])
    )
  }))
  
  res <- res[Variable %in% keep_terms]
  
  res[, stars := fcase(
    p < 0.001, "***",
    p < 0.01,  "**",
    p < 0.05,  "*",
    p < 0.1,   ".",
    default = ""
  )]
  
  res[, Variable := labels[Variable]]
  res[, valor := sprintf("%.3f%s\n(%.3f)", Coef, stars, SE)]
  
  taula <- dcast(
    res[, .(Variable, Comparacio, valor)],
    Variable ~ Comparacio,
    value.var = "valor",
    fill = ""
  )
  
  files_extra <- data.table(
    Variable = c("Observacions", "AIC", "Inclou CCAA", "Inclou períodes ficticis", "Pesos"),
    `Infraqualificacio` = c(nrow(base_data), round(AIC(model), 1), "Sí", "Sí", "Sí"),
    `Sobrequalificacio` = c(nrow(base_data), round(AIC(model), 1), "Sí", "Sí", "Sí")
  )
  
  rbind(taula, files_extra, fill = TRUE)
}

taula_multinom_ref <- extreure_taula_multinom(
  model = m_multinom_ref,
  keep_terms = keep_terms,
  labels = labels,
  base_data = base_multinom
)

cat("\nTaula neta del model:\n")
print(taula_multinom_ref)
View(taula_multinom_ref)

# 21) COMPROVACIÓ ESPECÍFICA DELS PERÍODES
cat("\nCoeficients dels períodes ficticis:\n")
print(coefs_ref[, grep("^PERIODE_f", colnames(coefs_ref), value = TRUE), drop = FALSE])

cat("\np-valors dels períodes ficticis:\n")
print(pvals_ref[, grep("^PERIODE_f", colnames(pvals_ref), value = TRUE), drop = FALSE])
```

```{r}
# 1) PROBABILITATS PREDIDES PER SEXE

pred_sexe_fun <- function(model, data, dona_val) {
  tmp <- copy(data)
  tmp[, dona := dona_val]
  
  probs <- as.data.table(as.matrix(predict(model, newdata = tmp, type = "probs")))
  
  data.table(
    Infraqualificacio = weighted.mean(probs$Infraqualificacio, w = data$pes_reesc, na.rm = TRUE),
    Ajust = weighted.mean(probs$Ajust, w = data$pes_reesc, na.rm = TRUE),
    Sobrequalificacio = weighted.mean(probs$Sobrequalificacio, w = data$pes_reesc, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

pred_sexe <- rbindlist(list(
  cbind(data.table(Sexe = "Homes"), pred_sexe_fun(m_multinom_ref, base_multinom, 0)),
  cbind(data.table(Sexe = "Dones"), pred_sexe_fun(m_multinom_ref, base_multinom, 1))
), fill = TRUE)

pred_sexe_long <- melt(
  pred_sexe,
  id.vars = "Sexe",
  variable.name = "Resultat",
  value.name = "Probabilitat"
)

# ordre dels panells: infra - ajust - sobre
pred_sexe_long[, Resultat := factor(
  Resultat,
  levels = c("Infraqualificacio", "Ajust", "Sobrequalificacio"),
  labels = c("Infraqualificació", "Ajust", "Sobrequalificació")
)]

g_sexe <- ggplot(pred_sexe_long, aes(x = Sexe, y = Probabilitat, fill = Resultat)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ Resultat, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Infraqualificació" = "red",
    "Ajust" = "grey70",
    "Sobrequalificació" = "olivedrab2"
  )) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(round(100*x, 0), "%")) +
  labs(
    title = "Probabilitats predides segons sexe",
    subtitle = "Model logit multinomial amb pesos",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Probabilitat predida"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none"
  )

print(g_sexe)

ggsave("multinom_pred_sexe.jpg", g_sexe, width = 9, height = 4.8, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
# 2) PROBABILITATS PREDIDES SEGONS EDAT I SEXE

pred_edat_sexe_fun <- function(model, data, edat_val, dona_val) {
  tmp <- copy(data)
  tmp[, dona := dona_val]
  tmp[, EDAT := edat_val]
  tmp[, EDAT_c := EDAT - edat_mitjana]
  tmp[, EDAT_c2 := EDAT_c^2]
  
  probs <- as.data.table(as.matrix(predict(model, newdata = tmp, type = "probs")))
  
  data.table(
    Ajust = weighted.mean(probs$Ajust, w = data$pes_reesc, na.rm = TRUE),
    Infraqualificacio = weighted.mean(probs$Infraqualificacio, w = data$pes_reesc, na.rm = TRUE),
    Sobrequalificacio = weighted.mean(probs$Sobrequalificacio, w = data$pes_reesc, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

pred_edat_sexe <- rbindlist(lapply(16:70, function(e) {
  rbindlist(lapply(c(0, 1), function(d) {
    dt <- pred_edat_sexe_fun(m_multinom_ref, base_multinom, e, d)
    dt[, `:=`(EDAT = e, dona = d)]
    dt
  }))
}), fill = TRUE)

pred_edat_sexe_long <- melt(
  pred_edat_sexe,
  id.vars = c("EDAT", "dona"),
  variable.name = "Resultat",
  value.name = "Probabilitat"
)

pred_edat_sexe_long[, Sexe := fifelse(dona == 1, "Dones", "Homes")]
pred_edat_sexe_long[, Resultat := factor(
  Resultat,
  levels = c("Ajust", "Infraqualificacio", "Sobrequalificacio"),
  labels = c("Ajust", "Infraqualificació", "Sobrequalificació")
)]

g_edat_sexe <- ggplot(
  pred_edat_sexe_long,
  aes(x = EDAT, y = Probabilitat, linetype = Sexe)
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  facet_wrap(~ Resultat, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(round(100*x, 0), "%")) +
  labs(
    title = "Probabilitats predides segons edat i sexe",
    subtitle = "Model logit multinomial amb pesos",
    x = "Edat",
    y = "Probabilitat predida",
    linetype = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

print(g_edat_sexe)

ggsave("multinom_pred_edat_sexe.jpg", g_edat_sexe, width = 10, height = 5.5, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}

# 3) COEFPLOT DE LES CCAA

coefs <- summary(m_multinom_ref)$coefficients
ses   <- summary(m_multinom_ref)$standard.errors

extreu_coef_multinom <- function(prefix) {
  dt <- rbindlist(lapply(rownames(coefs), function(cat) {
    vars <- grep(paste0("^", prefix), colnames(coefs), value = TRUE)
    data.table(
      Resultat = cat,
      Variable = vars,
      Coef = as.numeric(coefs[cat, vars]),
      SE = as.numeric(ses[cat, vars])
    )
  }))
  
  dt[, IC_low := Coef - 1.96 * SE]
  dt[, IC_high := Coef + 1.96 * SE]
  dt
}

coef_ccaa <- extreu_coef_multinom("CCAA_f")

labels_ccaa <- c(

  "CCAA_f10" = "Comunitat Valenciana",
  "CCAA_f11" = "Extremadura",
  "CCAA_f12" = "Galícia",
  "CCAA_f13" = "Madrid",
  "CCAA_f14" = "Múrcia",
  "CCAA_f15" = "Navarra",
  "CCAA_f16" = "País Basc",
  "CCAA_f17" = "La Rioja",
```

```{r}

# MODELS DE COMPARACIÓ + VISUAL DE ROBUSTESA


library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)

setDT(base_multinom)


# 1) VARIABLES BINÀRIES PER ALS MODELS DE COMPARACIÓ

base_multinom[, infra_bin := ifelse(DESAJUST_f == "Infraqualificacio", 1, 0)]
base_multinom[, sobre_bin := ifelse(DESAJUST_f == "Sobrequalificacio", 1, 0)]


# 2) MODELS PROBIT AMB PESOS

m_infra_probit_w <- glm(
  infra_bin ~ dona + EDAT_c + EDAT_c2 + CCAA_f + PERIODE_f,
  data = base_multinom,
  family = binomial(link = "probit"),
  weights = pes_reesc
)

m_sobre_probit_w <- glm(
  sobre_bin ~ dona + EDAT_c + EDAT_c2 + CCAA_f + PERIODE_f,
  data = base_multinom,
  family = binomial(link = "probit"),
  weights = pes_reesc
)


# 3) MODELS LOGIT AMB PESOS

m_infra_logit_w <- glm(
  infra_bin ~ dona + EDAT_c + EDAT_c2 + CCAA_f + PERIODE_f,
  data = base_multinom,
  family = binomial(link = "logit"),
  weights = pes_reesc
)

m_sobre_logit_w <- glm(
  sobre_bin ~ dona + EDAT_c + EDAT_c2 + CCAA_f + PERIODE_f,
  data = base_multinom,
  family = binomial(link = "logit"),
  weights = pes_reesc
)

# Si vols comprovar-los
summary(m_infra_probit_w)
summary(m_sobre_probit_w)
summary(m_infra_logit_w)
summary(m_sobre_logit_w)


# 4) FUNCIONS AUXILIARS PER CALCULAR EFECTES MARGINALS

edat_mitjana <- mean(base_multinom$EDAT, na.rm = TRUE)

pred_multinom_outcome <- function(model, data, outcome) {
  probs <- as.data.table(as.matrix(predict(model, newdata = data, type = "probs")))
  probs[[outcome]]
}

pred_binary <- function(model, data) {
  as.numeric(predict(model, newdata = data, type = "response"))
}

# ----- efecte marginal de variable binària (ex: dona)
ame_dummy_multinom <- function(model, data, var, outcome, weights_var = "pes_reesc") {
  d0 <- copy(data)
  d1 <- copy(data)
  
  d0[, (var) := 0]
  d1[, (var) := 1]
  
  p0 <- pred_multinom_outcome(model, d0, outcome)
  p1 <- pred_multinom_outcome(model, d1, outcome)
  
  weighted.mean(p1 - p0, w = data[[weights_var]], na.rm = TRUE)
}

ame_dummy_binary <- function(model, data, var, weights_var = "pes_reesc") {
  d0 <- copy(data)
  d1 <- copy(data)
  
  d0[, (var) := 0]
  d1[, (var) := 1]
  
  p0 <- pred_binary(model, d0)
  p1 <- pred_binary(model, d1)
  
  weighted.mean(p1 - p0, w = data[[weights_var]], na.rm = TRUE)
}

# ----- efecte marginal de l'edat
ame_edat_multinom <- function(model, data, outcome, pas = 1, weights_var = "pes_reesc") {
  d0 <- copy(data)
  d1 <- copy(data)
  
  d1[, EDAT := EDAT + pas]
  d1[, EDAT_c := EDAT - edat_mitjana]
  d1[, EDAT_c2 := EDAT_c^2]
  
  p0 <- pred_multinom_outcome(model, d0, outcome)
  p1 <- pred_multinom_outcome(model, d1, outcome)
  
  weighted.mean((p1 - p0) / pas, w = data[[weights_var]], na.rm = TRUE)
}

ame_edat_binary <- function(model, data, pas = 1, weights_var = "pes_reesc") {
  d0 <- copy(data)
  d1 <- copy(data)
  
  d1[, EDAT := EDAT + pas]
  d1[, EDAT_c := EDAT - edat_mitjana]
  d1[, EDAT_c2 := EDAT_c^2]
  
  p0 <- pred_binary(model, d0)
  p1 <- pred_binary(model, d1)
  
  weighted.mean((p1 - p0) / pas, w = data[[weights_var]], na.rm = TRUE)
}

# ----- efecte marginal dels períodes vs Recuperació
ame_periode_multinom <- function(model, data, periode_target, outcome,
                                 periode_ref = "Recuperacio_2014_2019",
                                 weights_var = "pes_reesc") {
  d_ref <- copy(data)
  d_tar <- copy(data)
  
  d_ref[, PERIODE_f := factor(periode_ref, levels = levels(data$PERIODE_f))]
  d_tar[, PERIODE_f := factor(periode_target, levels = levels(data$PERIODE_f))]
  
  p_ref <- pred_multinom_outcome(model, d_ref, outcome)
  p_tar <- pred_multinom_outcome(model, d_tar, outcome)
  
  weighted.mean(p_tar - p_ref, w = data[[weights_var]], na.rm = TRUE)
}

ame_periode_binary <- function(model, data, periode_target,
                               periode_ref = "Recuperacio_2014_2019",
                               weights_var = "pes_reesc") {
  d_ref <- copy(data)
  d_tar <- copy(data)
  
  d_ref[, PERIODE_f := factor(periode_ref, levels = levels(data$PERIODE_f))]
  d_tar[, PERIODE_f := factor(periode_target, levels = levels(data$PERIODE_f))]
  
  p_ref <- pred_binary(model, d_ref)
  p_tar <- pred_binary(model, d_tar)
  
  weighted.mean(p_tar - p_ref, w = data[[weights_var]], na.rm = TRUE)
}


# 5) TAULA D'EFECTES MARGINALS COMPARABLES
```

#2.Models amb pesos 
#(procediment exactament igual que l'anterior però amb pesos)
```{r}
library(data.table)
setDT(EPA_2005_2025v2)

# 1) buscar variable d'edat exacta
edat_var <- intersect(names(EPA_2005_2025v2), c("EDAT1", "EDAD1"))
if (length(edat_var) == 0) stop("No trobo la variable EDAT1/EDAD1")
edat_var <- edat_var[1]

# 2) ordre de menor a major nivell educatiu
ordre_nforma <- c("AN", "P1", "P2", "S1", "SG", "SP", "SU")

# 3) base inicial: només ocupats i observacions útils 
#(mateix criteri que models sense pesos)
base_probit <- EPA_2005_2025v2[
  ANY >= 2005 & ANY <= 2025 &
  !is.na(AOI) &
  trimws(as.character(AOI)) != "" &
  sprintf("%02d", as.integer(AOI)) %in% c("03", "04") &   # només ocupats
  !is.na(NFORMA) & trimws(as.character(NFORMA)) != "" &
  !is.na(OCUP1) & trimws(as.character(OCUP1)) != "" &
  trimws(as.character(OCUP1)) != "0" &                    # excloure militars
  !is.na(ANY) &
  !is.na(FACTOREL) &
  !is.na(SEXO1) & trimws(as.character(SEXO1)) %in% c("1", "6") &
  !is.na(CCAA) & trimws(as.character(CCAA)) != "",
  .(
    ANY,
    FACTOREL,
    NFORMA = trimws(as.character(NFORMA)),
    OCUP1 = trimws(as.character(OCUP1)),
    SEXO1 = trimws(as.character(SEXO1)),
    CCAA = sprintf("%02d", as.integer(CCAA)),
    ACT1 = trimws(as.character(ACT1)),
    DUCON1 = trimws(as.character(DUCON1)),
    PARCO1 = trimws(as.character(PARCO1)),
    EDAT = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(get(edat_var))))
  )
]

# 4) calcular la moda educativa per ocupació en tot el període 2005-2025
moda <- base_probit[
  ,
  .(pes = sum(FACTOREL, na.rm = TRUE)),
  by = .(OCUP1, NFORMA)
]

moda[, NFORMA := factor(NFORMA, levels = ordre_nforma, ordered = TRUE)]

# si hi ha empat, es queda amb la primera segons l'ordre educatiu
moda_final <- moda[
  order(OCUP1, -pes, NFORMA)
][
  , .SD[1], by = OCUP1
]

setnames(moda_final, "NFORMA", "NFORMA_MODA")

# 5) unir la moda a cada observació
base_probit[, NFORMA := factor(NFORMA, levels = ordre_nforma, ordered = TRUE)]

base_probit <- merge(
  base_probit,
  moda_final[, .(OCUP1, NFORMA_MODA)],
  by = "OCUP1",
  all.x = TRUE
)

# 6) construir variable de desajust
base_probit[, DESAJUST_MODA := fcase(
  NFORMA < NFORMA_MODA, "Infraqualificacio",
  NFORMA == NFORMA_MODA, "Ajust",
  NFORMA > NFORMA_MODA, "Sobrequalificacio"
)]

# 7) variables dependents binàries
base_probit[, sobre := ifelse(DESAJUST_MODA == "Sobrequalificacio", 1, 0)]
base_probit[, infra := ifelse(DESAJUST_MODA == "Infraqualificacio", 1, 0)]

# 8) variables explicatives
base_probit[, dona := ifelse(SEXO1 == "6", 1, 0)]
base_probit[, CCAA_f := factor(CCAA)]
base_probit[, ACT1_f := factor(ifelse(ACT1 == "", NA, ACT1))]
base_probit[, DUCON1_f := factor(ifelse(DUCON1 == "", NA, DUCON1))]
base_probit[, PARCO1_f := factor(ifelse(PARCO1 == "", NA, PARCO1))]

# 9) base per al model bàsic
base_basic <- base_probit[
  !is.na(sobre) & !is.na(infra) &
  !is.na(dona) & !is.na(EDAT) &
  !is.na(CCAA_f) & !is.na(ANY) &
  !is.na(FACTOREL)
]

# 10) centrar edat i any
base_basic[, EDAT_c := EDAT - mean(EDAT, na.rm = TRUE)]
base_basic[, EDAT_c2 := EDAT_c^2]
base_basic[, ANY_c := ANY - mean(ANY, na.rm = TRUE)]

# 11) pesos reescalats
#pas clau del model!!!!!
#dividim el factorel per la seva mitjana per evitar problemes de convergència i escala 
base_basic[, pes_model := FACTOREL / mean(FACTOREL, na.rm = TRUE)]

# 12) models bàsics amb pesos reescalats
m_sobre_basic_w <- glm(
  sobre ~ dona + EDAT_c + EDAT_c2 + CCAA_f + ANY_c,
  family = binomial(link = "probit"),
  data = base_basic,
  weights = pes_model
)

m_infra_basic_w <- glm(
  infra ~ dona + EDAT_c + EDAT_c2 + CCAA_f + ANY_c,
  family = binomial(link = "probit"),
  data = base_basic,
  weights = pes_model
)

# 13) base per al model ampliat
base_full <- base_basic[
  !is.na(ACT1_f) & !is.na(DUCON1_f) & !is.na(PARCO1_f)
]

# 14) models ampliats amb pesos reescalats
m_sobre_full_w <- glm(
  sobre ~ dona + EDAT_c + EDAT_c2 + CCAA_f + ANY_c + ACT1_f + DUCON1_f + PARCO1_f,
  family = binomial(link = "probit"),
  data = base_full,
  weights = pes_model
)

m_infra_full_w <- glm(
  infra ~ dona + EDAT_c + EDAT_c2 + CCAA_f + ANY_c + ACT1_f + DUCON1_f + PARCO1_f,
  family = binomial(link = "probit"),
  data = base_full,
  weights = pes_model
)

# 15) resultats
summary(m_sobre_basic_w)
summary(m_infra_basic_w)
summary(m_sobre_full_w)
summary(m_infra_full_w)

# 16) coeficients sols
coef(m_sobre_basic_w)
coef(m_infra_basic_w)
coef(m_sobre_full_w)
coef(m_infra_full_w)

# 17) mides de mostra
nrow(base_basic)
nrow(base_full)
```

#En aquest segon cop, també produim visuals per analitzar els models
````{r}
library(data.table)

#Models a mostrar
mod_infra <- m_infra_full
mod_sobre <- m_sobre_full

# variables a dibuixar
keep_terms <- c("dona", "EDAT_c", "EDAT_c2", "ANY_c", "DUCON1_f6", "PARCO1_f6")

labels <- c(
  "dona" = "Dona",
  "EDAT_c" = "Edat (centrada)",
  "EDAT_c2" = "Edat²",
  "ANY_c" = "Any (centrat)",
  "DUCON1_f6" = "Contracte temporal",
  "PARCO1_f6" = "Jornada parcial"
)

extreure_coefplot <- function(model, tipus_model){
  cf <- coef(model)
  se <- sqrt(diag(vcov(model)))
  
  dt <- data.table(
    term = names(cf),
    coef = as.numeric(cf),
    se = as.numeric(se)
  )
  
  dt <- dt[term %in% keep_terms]
  dt[, low := coef - 1.96 * se]
  dt[, high := coef + 1.96 * se]
  dt[, variable := labels[term]]
  dt[, model := tipus_model]
  
  dt[, .(variable, coef, low, high, model)]
}

coef_infra <- extreure_coefplot(mod_infra, "Infraqualificació")
coef_sobre <- extreure_coefplot(mod_sobre, "Sobrequalificació")

jpeg("coefplot_models_ampliats.jpg", width = 2200, height = 1200, res = 200)

par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = c(7, 8, 4, 2), oma = c(0, 0, 2, 0))

for(dt in list(coef_infra, coef_sobre)){
  
  dt <- copy(dt)
  dt[, ypos := .I]
  
  xlim_comu <- range(c(dt$low, dt$high), na.rm = TRUE)
  marge <- 0.1 * diff(xlim_comu)
  xlim_comu <- c(xlim_comu[1] - marge, xlim_comu[2] + marge)
  
  plot(
    dt$coef, dt$ypos,
    xlim = xlim_comu,
    ylim = c(0.5, nrow(dt) + 0.5),
    pch = 19,
    yaxt = "n",
    xlab = "Coeficient estimat",
    ylab = "",
    main = unique(dt$model)
  )

  axis(2, at = dt$ypos, labels = dt$variable, las = 2, cex.axis = 0.9)
}
````

````{r}
library(data.table)

# funció per calcular AME d'una dummy (0/1)
ame_dummy <- function(model, data, var){
  d0 <- copy(data)
  d1 <- copy(data)
  
  d0[[var]] <- 0
  d1[[var]] <- 1
  
  p0 <- predict(model, newdata = d0, type = "response")
  p1 <- predict(model, newdata = d1, type = "response")
  
  ame_i <- p1 - p0
  
  ame <- mean(ame_i, na.rm = TRUE)
  se  <- sd(ame_i, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(ame_i)))
  
  data.table(
    variable = var,
    ame = ame,
    low = ame - 1.96 * se,
    high = ame + 1.96 * se
  )
}

# funció per calcular AME d'una continua
ame_cont <- function(model, data, var, delta = 1){
  d0 <- copy(data)
  d1 <- copy(data)
  
  d1[[var]] <- d1[[var]] + delta
  
  # si edat centrada, actualizar també edat²
  if (var == "EDAT_c" && "EDAT_c2" %in% names(d1)) {
    d1[["EDAT_c2"]] <- d1[["EDAT_c"]]^2
  }
  
  p0 <- predict(model, newdata = d0, type = "response")
  p1 <- predict(model, newdata = d1, type = "response")
  
  ame_i <- (p1 - p0) / delta
  
  ame <- mean(ame_i, na.rm = TRUE)
  se  <- sd(ame_i, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(ame_i)))
  
  data.table(
    variable = var,
    ame = ame,
    low = ame - 1.96 * se,
    high = ame + 1.96 * se
  )
}

# models ampliats
mod_infra <- m_infra_full
mod_sobre <- m_sobre_full

# dades de referència
dat_infra <- copy(base_full)
dat_sobre <- copy(base_full)

# calcular AME per infra
ame_infra <- rbindlist(list(
  ame_dummy(mod_infra, dat_infra, "dona"),
  ame_cont(mod_infra, dat_infra, "EDAT_c"),
  ame_cont(mod_infra, dat_infra, "ANY_c"),
  ame_dummy(mod_infra, dat_infra, "DUCON1_f6"),
  ame_dummy(mod_infra, dat_infra, "PARCO1_f6")
), use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)

ame_infra[, model := "Infraqualificació"]

# calcular AME per sobre
ame_sobre <- rbindlist(list(
  ame_dummy(mod_sobre, dat_sobre, "dona"),
  ame_cont(mod_sobre, dat_sobre, "EDAT_c"),
  ame_cont(mod_sobre, dat_sobre, "ANY_c"),
  ame_dummy(mod_sobre, dat_sobre, "DUCON1_f6"),
  ame_dummy(mod_sobre, dat_sobre, "PARCO1_f6")
), use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)

ame_sobre[, model := "Sobrequalificació"]

# unir
ame_all <- rbindlist(list(ame_infra, ame_sobre), use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)

# etiquetes 
labels <- c(
  "dona" = "Dona",
  "EDAT_c" = "Edat",
  "ANY_c" = "Any",
  "DUCON1_f6" = "Contracte temporal",
  "PARCO1_f6" = "Jornada parcial"
)

ame_all[, variable_lab := labels[variable]]

# ordre de variables
ordre_vars <- c("Dona", "Edat", "Any", "Contracte temporal", "Jornada parcial")
ame_all[, variable_lab := factor(variable_lab, levels = ordre_vars)]

jpeg("ame_models_ampliats.jpg", width = 2200, height = 1200, res = 200)

par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = c(7, 8, 4, 2), oma = c(0, 0, 2, 0))

for(mod in c("Infraqualificació", "Sobrequalificació")){
  
  dt <- copy(ame_all[model == mod])
  dt <- dt[order(variable_lab)]
  dt[, ypos := .I]
  
  xlim_comu <- range(c(dt$low, dt$high), na.rm = TRUE)
  marge <- 0.15 * diff(xlim_comu)
  xlim_comu <- c(xlim_comu[1] - marge, xlim_comu[2] + marge)
  
  plot(
    dt$ame, dt$ypos,
    xlim = xlim_comu,
    ylim = c(0.5, nrow(dt) + 0.5),
    pch = 19,
    yaxt = "n",
    xlab = "Efecte marginal mitjà",
    ylab = "",
    main = mod
  )
  
  segments(dt$low, dt$ypos, dt$high, dt$ypos, lwd = 2)
  abline(v = 0, lty = 2, col = "gray40")
  
  axis(2, at = dt$ypos, labels = dt$variable_lab, las = 2, cex.axis = 0.9)
}

mtext("Efectes marginals mitjans dels principals regressors", outer = TRUE, cex = 1.3)

dev.off()
````

```{r}
library(data.table)

# variables a mostrar
keep_terms <- c("dona", "EDAT_c", "EDAT_c2", "ANY_c", "DUCON1_f6", "PARCO1_f6")

# noms 
labels <- c(
  "dona" = "Dona",
  "EDAT_c" = "Edat (centrada)",
  "EDAT_c2" = "Edat²",
  "ANY_c" = "Any (centrat)",
  "DUCON1_f6" = "Contracte temporal",
  "PARCO1_f6" = "Jornada parcial"
)

# funció per extreure resultats d'un model
extreure_model <- function(model, nom_columna, keep_terms, labels){
  
  coefs <- as.data.table(summary(model)$coefficients, keep.rownames = "Variable")
  
  setnames(
    coefs,
    c("Variable", "Estimate", "Std. Error", "z value", "Pr(>|z|)"),
    c("Variable", "Coef", "SE", "z", "p")
  )
  
  coefs <- coefs[Variable %in% keep_terms]
  
  coefs[, stars := fcase(
    p < 0.001, "***",
    p < 0.01,  "**",
    p < 0.05,  "*",
    p < 0.1,   ".",
    default = ""
  )]
  
  coefs[, Variable := labels[Variable]]
  coefs[, valor := sprintf("%.3f%s\n(%.3f)", Coef, stars, SE)]
  
  coefs[, .(Variable, valor)]
  setnames(coefs, "valor", nom_columna)
  
  return(coefs)
}

# --------- TRIA AQUÍ ELS DOS MODELS A COMPARAR ---------
# Exemple 1: sobre ampliat
taula_probit <- extreure_model(m_sobre_full, "Probit", keep_terms, labels)
taula_logit  <- extreure_model(m_sobre_full_logit, "Logit", keep_terms, labels)

# Si vols comparar un altre parell, substitueix per:
# m_sobre_basic i m_sobre_basic_logit
# m_infra_basic i m_infra_basic_logit
# m_infra_full  i m_infra_full_logit
# --------------------------------------------------------

# unir les dues columnes
taula_compare <- merge(taula_probit, taula_logit, by = "Variable", all = TRUE)

# assegurar ordre de files
ordre_files <- c(
  "Dona",
  "Edat (centrada)",
  "Edat²",
  "Any (centrat)",
  "Contracte temporal",
  "Jornada parcial"
)

taula_base <- data.table(Variable = ordre_files)
taula_compare <- merge(taula_base, taula_compare, by = "Variable", all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
taula_compare[is.na(taula_compare)] <- ""

print(taula_compare)
View(taula_compare)
```

```{r}
library(data.table)

# noms de les CCAA
noms_ccaa <- c(
  "01" = "Andalusia",
  "02" = "Aragó",
  "03" = "Astúries",
  "04" = "Illes Balears",
  "05" = "Canàries",
  "06" = "Cantàbria",
  "07" = "Castella i Lleó",
  "08" = "Castella-La Manxa",
  "09" = "Catalunya",
  "10" = "Comunitat Valenciana",
  "11" = "Extremadura",
  "12" = "Galícia",
  "13" = "Madrid",
  "14" = "Múrcia",
  "15" = "Navarra",
  "16" = "País Basc",
  "17" = "La Rioja",
  "51" = "Ceuta",
  "52" = "Melilla"
)

grafic_model_basic <- function(model, data, titol_general, ylab_prob = "Probabilitat predida") {
  
  ccaa_levels <- levels(data$CCAA_f)
  ccaa_ref <- ccaa_levels[1]
  
  any_mean <- mean(data$ANY, na.rm = TRUE)
  edat_mean <- mean(data$EDAT, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  anys <- seq(min(data$ANY, na.rm = TRUE), max(data$ANY, na.rm = TRUE), by = 1)
  edats <- seq(floor(min(data$EDAT, na.rm = TRUE)), ceiling(max(data$EDAT, na.rm = TRUE)), by = 1)
  
  # 1) DONA
  pred_dona <- data.table(
    grup = c("Home", "Dona"),
    dona = c(0, 1),
    EDAT_c = 0,
    EDAT_c2 = 0,
    CCAA_f = factor(ccaa_ref, levels = ccaa_levels),
    ANY_c = 0
  )
  
  pred_dona[, p := predict(model, newdata = pred_dona, type = "response")]
  
  # 2) ANY_c
  pred_any <- data.table(
    ANY = anys,
    dona = 0,
    EDAT_c = 0,
    EDAT_c2 = 0,
    CCAA_f = factor(ccaa_ref, levels = ccaa_levels)
  )
  
  pred_any[, ANY_c := ANY - any_mean]
  pred_any[, p := predict(model, newdata = pred_any, type = "response")]
  
  # 3) EDAT (representa EDAT_c i EDAT_c2 correctament)
  pred_edat <- data.table(
    EDAT = edats,
    dona = 0,
    CCAA_f = factor(ccaa_ref, levels = ccaa_levels),
    ANY_c = 0
  )
  
  pred_edat[, EDAT_c := EDAT - edat_mean]
  pred_edat[, EDAT_c2 := EDAT_c^2]
  pred_edat[, p := predict(model, newdata = pred_edat, type = "response")]
  
  # 4) CCAA mínima i màxima
  pred_ccaa <- data.table(
    CCAA_f = factor(ccaa_levels, levels = ccaa_levels),
    dona = 0,
    EDAT_c = 0,
    EDAT_c2 = 0,
    ANY_c = 0
  )
  
  pred_ccaa[, p := predict(model, newdata = pred_ccaa, type = "response")]
  pred_ccaa[, CCAA := noms_ccaa[as.character(CCAA_f)]]
  
  ccaa_min <- pred_ccaa[which.min(p)]
  ccaa_max <- pred_ccaa[which.max(p)]
  pred_ccaa_ext <- rbind(ccaa_min, ccaa_max)
  
  # gràfics
  par(mfrow = c(2, 2), mar = c(5, 5, 4, 2), oma = c(0, 0, 2, 0))
  
  # dona
  bp1 <- barplot(
    pred_dona$p,
    names.arg = pred_dona$grup,
    ylim = c(0, max(pred_dona$p) * 1.25),
    ylab = ylab_prob,
    main = "Efecte de dona"
  )
  text(bp1, pred_dona$p, labels = round(pred_dona$p, 3), pos = 3)
  
  # any
  plot(
    pred_any$ANY, pred_any$p,
    type = "l",
    lwd = 2,
    xlab = "Any",
    ylab = ylab_prob,
    main = "Efecte de l'any"
  )
  
  # edat
  plot(
    pred_edat$EDAT, pred_edat$p,
    type = "l",
    lwd = 2,
    xlab = "Edat",
    ylab = ylab_prob,
    main = "Efecte de l'edat"
  )
  
  # CCAA extrema
  bp2 <- barplot(
    pred_ccaa_ext$p,
    names.arg = pred_ccaa_ext$CCAA,
    ylim = c(0, max(pred_ccaa_ext$p) * 1.25),
    ylab = ylab_prob,
    main = "CCAA mínima i màxima",
    las = 2
  )
  text(bp2, pred_ccaa_ext$p, labels = round(pred_ccaa_ext$p, 3), pos = 3, cex = 0.9)
  
  mtext(titol_general, outer = TRUE, cex = 1.2)
}

# -------- EXECUCIÓ --------

# per al model bàsic de sobrequalificació
grafic_model_basic(
  model = m_sobre_basic,
  data = base_basic,
  titol_general = "Visualització del model probit bàsic de sobrequalificació"
)

# per al model bàsic d'infraqualificació
grafic_model_basic(
  model = m_infra_basic,
  data = base_basic,
  titol_general = "Visualització del model probit bàsic d'infraqualificació"
)
```

```{r}
# funció per trobar la moda d'una variable
moda_valor <- function(x){
  ux <- na.omit(x)
  names(sort(table(ux), decreasing = TRUE))[1]
}

# ---- TRIAR MODEL ----
model_ccaa <- m_sobre_full

any_mean  <- mean(base_full$ANY, na.rm = TRUE)

ducon_ref <- moda_valor(base_full$DUCON1_f)

  CCAA_f = factor(levels(base_full$CCAA_f), levels = levels(base_full$CCAA_f)),

)

# variables centrades

pred_ccaa[, EDAT_c2 := EDAT_c^2]
pred_ccaa[, ANY_c := ANY - any_mean]

pred_ccaa[, CCAA := noms_ccaa[codi]]

# ordenar de menor a major probabilitat

pred_ccaa[, ypos := 1:.N]

# marcar extrems
```

```{r}
library(data.table)

noms_ccaa <- c(
  "01" = "Andalusia",
  "02" = "Aragó",
  "03" = "Astúries",
  "04" = "Illes Balears",
  "05" = "Canàries",
  "06" = "Cantàbria",
  "07" = "Castella i Lleó",
  "08" = "Castella-La Manxa",
  "09" = "Catalunya",
  "10" = "Comunitat Valenciana",
  "11" = "Extremadura",
  "12" = "Galícia",
  "13" = "Madrid",
  "14" = "Múrcia",
  "15" = "Navarra",
  "16" = "País Basc",
  "17" = "La Rioja",
  "51" = "Ceuta",
  "52" = "Melilla"
)

# Función para calcular la moda
moda_valor <- function(x) {
  ux <- na.omit(x)
  names(sort(table(ux), decreasing = TRUE))[1]
}

# Función para preparar predicciones por CCAA
fer_pred_ccaa <- function(model, titol_model) {

  edat_mean <- mean(base_full$EDAT, na.rm = TRUE)
  any_mean  <- mean(base_full$ANY, na.rm = TRUE)

  act1_ref  <- moda_valor(base_full$ACT1_f)
  ducon_ref <- moda_valor(base_full$DUCON1_f)
  parco_ref <- moda_valor(base_full$PARCO1_f)

  pred_ccaa <- data.table(
    CCAA_f = factor(levels(base_full$CCAA_f), levels = levels(base_full$CCAA_f)),
    dona = 0,
    EDAT = edat_mean,
    ANY = any_mean,
    ACT1_f = factor(act1_ref, levels = levels(base_full$ACT1_f)),
    DUCON1_f = factor(ducon_ref, levels = levels(base_full$DUCON1_f)),
    PARCO1_f = factor(parco_ref, levels = levels(base_full$PARCO1_f))
  )

  pred_ccaa[, EDAT_c := EDAT - edat_mean]
  pred_ccaa[, EDAT_c2 := EDAT_c^2]
  pred_ccaa[, ANY_c := ANY - any_mean]

  pred_ccaa[, p := predict(model, newdata = pred_ccaa, type = "response")]
  pred_ccaa[, codi := as.character(CCAA_f)]
  pred_ccaa[, CCAA := noms_ccaa[codi]]

  pred_ccaa <- pred_ccaa[order(p)]
  pred_ccaa[, ypos := 1:.N]
  pred_ccaa[, color := "gray40"]
  pred_ccaa[1:3, color := "firebrick3"]
  pred_ccaa[(.N-2):.N, color := "darkgreen"]

  list(data = pred_ccaa, titol = titol_model)
}

g_infra <- fer_pred_ccaa(m_infra_full_w, "Infraqualificació")
g_sobre <- fer_pred_ccaa(m_sobre_full_w, "Sobrequalificació")
```

```{r}
# ==================================================
# 0) PREPARACIÓ
# ==================================================
setwd("~/Desktop/DADES")
load("EPA_2005_2025v2.RData")
rm(list = setdiff(ls(), "EPA_2005_2025v2"))

library(data.table)
setDT(EPA_2005_2025v2)

# ==================================================
# 1) ANY
# ==================================================
if (!"ANY" %in% names(EPA_2005_2025v2)) {
  EPA_2005_2025v2[, ciclo_num := suppressWarnings(as.integer(as.character(CICLO)))]
  
  EPA_2005_2025v2[, ANY := fifelse(
    !is.na(ciclo_num),
    2005L + (ciclo_num - 130L) %/% 4L,
    NA_integer_
  )]
  
  EPA_2005_2025v2[, ciclo_num := NULL]
}

# ==================================================
# 2) EDAT EXACTA HARMONITZADA
#    prioritat: EDAT_NUM_1 -> EDAT_NUM_2 -> EDAD1 -> EDAT1
# ==================================================
EPA_2005_2025v2[, EDAT := NA_real_]

if ("EDAT_NUM_1" %in% names(EPA_2005_2025v2)) {
  EPA_2005_2025v2[, EDAT := suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(EDAT_NUM_1)))]
}

if ("EDAT_NUM_2" %in% names(EPA_2005_2025v2)) {
  EPA_2005_2025v2[is.na(EDAT), EDAT := suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(EDAT_NUM_2)))]
}

if ("EDAD1" %in% names(EPA_2005_2025v2)) {
  EPA_2005_2025v2[is.na(EDAT), EDAT := suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(EDAD1)))]
}

if ("EDAT1" %in% names(EPA_2005_2025v2)) {
  EPA_2005_2025v2[is.na(EDAT), EDAT := suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(EDAT1)))]
}

# ==================================================
# 3) ORDRE EDUCATIU
# ==================================================
ordre_nforma <- c("AN", "P1", "P2", "S1", "SG", "SP", "SU")

# ==================================================
# 4) BASE INICIAL
#    només ocupats, 2005-2025, sense militars
# ==================================================
base_model <- EPA_2005_2025v2[
  ANY >= 2005 & ANY <= 2025 &
    !is.na(AOI) &
    trimws(as.character(AOI)) != "" &
    sprintf("%02d", as.integer(AOI)) %in% c("03", "04") &   # ocupats
    !is.na(NFORMA) & trimws(as.character(NFORMA)) != "" &
    !is.na(OCUP1) & trimws(as.character(OCUP1)) != "" &
    trimws(as.character(OCUP1)) != "0" &                    # excloure militars
    !is.na(ANY) &
    !is.na(SEXO1) & trimws(as.character(SEXO1)) %in% c("1", "6") &
    !is.na(CCAA) & trimws(as.character(CCAA)) != "" &
    !is.na(EDAT) &
    !is.na(FACTOREL),
  .(
    ANY,
    NFORMA = trimws(as.character(NFORMA)),
    OCUP1 = trimws(as.character(OCUP1)),
    SEXO1 = trimws(as.character(SEXO1)),
    CCAA = sprintf("%02d", as.integer(CCAA)),
    EDAT,
    FACTOREL
  )
]

# ==================================================
# 5) MODA EDUCATIVA GLOBAL PER OCUPACIÓ
# ==================================================
moda <- base_model[, .N, by = .(OCUP1, NFORMA)]
moda[, NFORMA := factor(NFORMA, levels = ordre_nforma, ordered = TRUE)]

moda_final <- moda[
  order(OCUP1, -N, NFORMA)
][
  , .SD[1], by = OCUP1
]

setnames(moda_final, "NFORMA", "NFORMA_MODA")

# ==================================================
# 6) ASSIGNAR MODA A CADA OBSERVACIÓ
# ==================================================
base_model[, NFORMA := factor(NFORMA, levels = ordre_nforma, ordered = TRUE)]

base_model <- merge(
  base_model,
  moda_final[, .(OCUP1, NFORMA_MODA)],
  by = "OCUP1",
  all.x = TRUE
)

# ==================================================
# 7) VARIABLE DE DESAJUST
# ==================================================
base_model[, DESAJUST_MODA := fcase(
  NFORMA < NFORMA_MODA, "Infraqualificacio",
  NFORMA == NFORMA_MODA, "Ajust",
  NFORMA > NFORMA_MODA, "Sobrequalificacio"
)]

# variables dependents binàries
base_model[, sobre := ifelse(DESAJUST_MODA == "Sobrequalificacio", 1, 0)]
base_model[, infra := ifelse(DESAJUST_MODA == "Infraqualificacio", 1, 0)]

# ==================================================
# 8) VARIABLES EXPLICATIVES
# ==================================================
base_model[, dona := ifelse(SEXO1 == "6", 1, 0)]
base_model[, CCAA_f := factor(CCAA)]

# mostra final amb observacions completes
base_model <- base_model[
  !is.na(sobre) & !is.na(infra) &
    !is.na(dona) & !is.na(EDAT) &
    !is.na(CCAA_f) & !is.na(ANY) &
    !is.na(FACTOREL)
]

# centrar edat i any
base_model[, EDAT_c := EDAT - mean(EDAT, na.rm = TRUE)]
base_model[, EDAT_c2 := EDAT_c^2]
base_model[, ANY_c := ANY - mean(ANY, na.rm = TRUE)]

# pesos reescalats
base_model[, pes_reesc := FACTOREL / mean(FACTOREL, na.rm = TRUE)]

# ==================================================
# 9) MODELS PROBIT SENSE PESOS
# ==================================================
m_sobre_probit <- glm(
  sobre ~ dona + EDAT_c + EDAT_c2 + CCAA_f + ANY_c,
  family = binomial(link = "probit"),
  data = base_model
)

m_infra_probit <- glm(
  infra ~ dona + EDAT_c + EDAT_c2 + CCAA_f + ANY_c,
  family = binomial(link = "probit"),
  data = base_model
)

# ==================================================
# 10) MODELS PROBIT AMB PESOS REESCALATS
# ==================================================
m_sobre_probit_w <- suppressWarnings(
  glm(
    sobre ~ dona + EDAT_c + EDAT_c2 + CCAA_f + ANY_c,
    family = binomial(link = "probit"),
    data = base_model,
    weights = pes_reesc
  )
)

m_infra_probit_w <- suppressWarnings(
  glm(
    infra ~ dona + EDAT_c + EDAT_c2 + CCAA_f + ANY_c,
    family = binomial(link = "probit"),
    data = base_model,
    weights = pes_reesc
  )
)

# ==================================================
# 11) MODELS LOGIT
# ==================================================
m_sobre_logit <- glm(
  sobre ~ dona + EDAT_c + EDAT_c2 + CCAA_f + ANY_c,
  family = binomial(link = "logit"),
  data = base_model
)

m_infra_logit <- glm(
  infra ~ dona + EDAT_c + EDAT_c2 + CCAA_f + ANY_c,
  family = binomial(link = "logit"),
  data = base_model
)

# ==================================================
# 12) RESULTATS BÀSICS
# ==================================================
summary(m_sobre_probit)
summary(m_infra_probit)

summary(m_sobre_probit_w)
summary(m_infra_probit_w)

summary(m_sobre_logit)
summary(m_infra_logit)

# coeficients
coef(m_sobre_probit)
coef(m_infra_probit)

coef(m_sobre_probit_w)
coef(m_infra_probit_w)

coef(m_sobre_logit)
coef(m_infra_logit)

# mida de mostra
nrow(base_model)
```

```{r}
# ==================================================
# RESULTATS DELS MODELS
# ==================================================

library(data.table)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 1) SUMMARIES DELS MODELS
# --------------------------------------------------
summary(m_infra_probit)
summary(m_infra_probit_w)
summary(m_infra_logit)

summary(m_sobre_probit)
summary(m_sobre_probit_w)
summary(m_sobre_logit)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 2) COEFICIENTS DIRECTES (OPCIONAL)
# --------------------------------------------------
coef(m_infra_probit)
coef(m_infra_probit_w)
coef(m_infra_logit)

coef(m_sobre_probit)
coef(m_sobre_probit_w)
coef(m_sobre_logit)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 3) MIDA DE MOSTRA
# --------------------------------------------------
nobs(m_infra_probit)
nobs(m_infra_probit_w)
nobs(m_infra_logit)

nobs(m_sobre_probit)
nobs(m_sobre_probit_w)
nobs(m_sobre_logit)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 4) VARIABLES A MOSTRAR A LA TAULA DEL TFG
# --------------------------------------------------
keep_terms <- c("dona", "EDAT_c", "EDAT_c2", "ANY_c")

labels <- c(
  "dona" = "Dona",
  "EDAT_c" = "Edat (centrada)",
  "EDAT_c2" = "Edat²",
  "ANY_c" = "Any (centrat)"
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 5) FUNCIÓ PER EXTREURE RESULTATS DEL MODEL
# --------------------------------------------------
extreure_taula <- function(model, nom_model, keep_terms, labels) {
  
  mat <- coef(summary(model))
  
  coefs <- data.table(
    Variable = rownames(mat),
    as.data.table(mat)
  )
  
  # detectar nom de la columna del p-valor
  p_col <- grep("^Pr\\(", names(coefs), value = TRUE)
  if (length(p_col) == 0) {
    stop("No s'ha trobat la columna del p-valor al summary(model).")
  }
  p_col <- p_col[1]
  
  # detectar nom de la columna de l'estadístic
  stat_col <- setdiff(names(coefs), c("Variable", "Estimate", "Std. Error", p_col))
  stat_col <- stat_col[1]
  
  setnames(
    coefs,
    old = c("Estimate", "Std. Error", stat_col, p_col),
    new = c("Coef", "SE", "stat", "p")
  )
  
  coefs <- coefs[Variable %in% keep_terms]
  
  coefs[, stars := fcase(
    p < 0.001, "***",
    p < 0.01,  "**",
    p < 0.05,  "*",
    p < 0.1,   ".",
    default = ""
  )]
  
  coefs[, Variable := labels[Variable]]
  coefs[, valor := sprintf("%.3f%s\n(%.3f)", Coef, stars, SE)]
  coefs[, Model := nom_model]
  
  coefs[, .(Variable, Model, valor)]
}

# --------------------------------------------------
# 6) EXTREURE RESULTATS DELS 6 MODELS
# --------------------------------------------------
t1 <- extreure_taula(m_infra_probit,   "Infra probit",        keep_terms, labels)
t2 <- extreure_taula(m_infra_probit_w, "Infra probit pesos",  keep_terms, labels)
t3 <- extreure_taula(m_infra_logit,    "Infra logit",         keep_terms, labels)

t4 <- extreure_taula(m_sobre_probit,   "Sobre probit",        keep_terms, labels)
t5 <- extreure_taula(m_sobre_probit_w, "Sobre probit pesos",  keep_terms, labels)
t6 <- extreure_taula(m_sobre_logit,    "Sobre logit",         keep_terms, labels)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 7) UNIFICAR TAULES
# --------------------------------------------------
taula_tfg <- rbindlist(list(t1, t2, t3, t4, t5, t6), use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)

taula_tfg <- dcast(
  taula_tfg,
  Variable ~ Model,
  value.var = "valor",
  fill = ""
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 8) ORDENAR FILES
# --------------------------------------------------
ordre_files <- c(
  "Dona",
  "Edat (centrada)",
  "Edat²",
  "Any (centrat)"
)

taula_base <- data.table(Variable = ordre_files)

taula_tfg <- merge(
  taula_base,
  taula_tfg,
  by = "Variable",
  all.x = TRUE,
  sort = FALSE
)

taula_tfg[is.na(taula_tfg)] <- ""

# --------------------------------------------------
# 9) FILES EXTRA DE RESUM
# --------------------------------------------------
files_extra <- data.table(
  Variable = c("Observacions", "AIC", "Inclou CCAA", "Pesos", "Funció d'enllaç"),
  `Infra probit`       = c(nobs(m_infra_probit),   round(AIC(m_infra_probit), 1),   "Sí", "No", "Probit"),
  `Infra probit pesos` = c(nobs(m_infra_probit_w), round(AIC(m_infra_probit_w), 1), "Sí", "Sí", "Probit"),
  `Infra logit`        = c(nobs(m_infra_logit),    round(AIC(m_infra_logit), 1),    "Sí", "No", "Logit"),
  `Sobre probit`       = c(nobs(m_sobre_probit),   round(AIC(m_sobre_probit), 1),   "Sí", "No", "Probit"),
  `Sobre probit pesos` = c(nobs(m_sobre_probit_w), round(AIC(m_sobre_probit_w), 1), "Sí", "Sí", "Probit"),
  `Sobre logit`        = c(nobs(m_sobre_logit),    round(AIC(m_sobre_logit), 1),    "Sí", "No", "Logit")
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 10) ORDENAR COLUMNES
# --------------------------------------------------
ordre_cols <- c(
  "Variable",
  "Infra probit",
  "Infra probit pesos",
  "Infra logit",
  "Sobre probit",
  "Sobre probit pesos",
  "Sobre logit"
)

taula_tfg <- taula_tfg[, ..ordre_cols]

taula_tfg_final <- rbind(taula_tfg, files_extra, fill = TRUE)
taula_tfg_final <- taula_tfg_final[, ..ordre_cols]

# --------------------------------------------------
# 11) VEURE RESULTAT FINAL
# --------------------------------------------------
print(taula_tfg_final)
View(taula_tfg_final)
```

```{r}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)

setDT(base_model)

# --------------------------------------------
# 1) MITJANES USADES EN EL CENTRATGE
# --------------------------------------------
mitjana_edat <- mean(base_model$EDAT, na.rm = TRUE)
mitjana_any  <- mean(base_model$ANY,  na.rm = TRUE)

# --------------------------------------------
# 2) FUNCIONS PER CALCULAR AME
# --------------------------------------------

# efecte marginal mitjà per variable binària
ame_binaria <- function(model, data, var, weights_var = NULL) {
  d0 <- copy(data)
  d1 <- copy(data)
  
  d0[, (var) := 0]
  d1[, (var) := 1]
  
  p0 <- predict(model, newdata = d0, type = "response")
  p1 <- predict(model, newdata = d1, type = "response")
  
  dif <- p1 - p0
  
  if (is.null(weights_var)) {
    return(mean(dif, na.rm = TRUE))
  } else {
    return(weighted.mean(dif, w = data[[weights_var]], na.rm = TRUE))
  }
}

# efecte marginal mitjà de l'edat
ame_edat <- function(model, data, pas = 1, weights_var = NULL, mean_edat) {
  d0 <- copy(data)
  d1 <- copy(data)
  
  d1[, EDAT := EDAT + pas]
  d1[, EDAT_c := EDAT - mean_edat]
  d1[, EDAT_c2 := EDAT_c^2]
  
  p0 <- predict(model, newdata = d0, type = "response")
  p1 <- predict(model, newdata = d1, type = "response")
  
  dif <- (p1 - p0) / pas
  
  if (is.null(weights_var)) {
    return(mean(dif, na.rm = TRUE))
  } else {
    return(weighted.mean(dif, w = data[[weights_var]], na.rm = TRUE))
  }
}

# efecte marginal mitjà de l'any
ame_any <- function(model, data, pas = 1, weights_var = NULL, mean_any) {
  d0 <- copy(data)
  d1 <- copy(data)
  
  d1[, ANY := ANY + pas]
  d1[, ANY_c := ANY - mean_any]
  
  p0 <- predict(model, newdata = d0, type = "response")
  p1 <- predict(model, newdata = d1, type = "response")
  
  dif <- (p1 - p0) / pas
  
  if (is.null(weights_var)) {
    return(mean(dif, na.rm = TRUE))
  } else {
    return(weighted.mean(dif, w = data[[weights_var]], na.rm = TRUE))
  }
}

# funció resum
calcula_ame_model <- function(model, data, resultat, model_nom, weights_var = NULL,
                              mean_edat, mean_any) {
  
  data.table(
    resultat = resultat,
    model = model_nom,
    Variable = c("Dona", "Edat", "Any"),
    AME = c(
      ame_binaria(model, data, "dona", weights_var = weights_var),
      ame_edat(model, data, weights_var = weights_var, mean_edat = mean_edat),
      ame_any(model, data, weights_var = weights_var, mean_any = mean_any)
    )
  )
}

# --------------------------------------------
# 3) AME DEL MODEL PROBIT SENSE PESOS
# --------------------------------------------
ame_probit_principal <- rbindlist(list(
  calcula_ame_model(
    m_sobre_probit, base_model,
    resultat = "Sobrequalificació",
    model_nom = "Probit",
    weights_var = NULL,
    mean_edat = mitjana_edat,
    mean_any = mitjana_any
  ),
  calcula_ame_model(
    m_infra_probit, base_model,
    resultat = "Infraqualificació",
    model_nom = "Probit",
    weights_var = NULL,
    mean_edat = mitjana_edat,
    mean_any = mitjana_any
  )
))

print(ame_probit_principal)
View(ame_probit_principal)

# --------------------------------------------
# 4) GRÀFIC AME MODEL PRINCIPAL
# --------------------------------------------
g_ame_probit <- ggplot(
  ame_probit_principal,
  aes(x = AME, y = Variable)
) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "gray60") +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = AME, y = Variable, yend = Variable), linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~ resultat, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(
    title = "Efectes marginals mitjans del model probit sense pesos",
    x = "Canvi mitjà en la probabilitat",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

print(g_ame_probit)

ggsave(
  "ame_probit_sense_pesos.jpg",
  g_ame_probit,
  width = 10,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)
```

```{r}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)

setDT(base_model)

# --------------------------------------------
# 1) MITJANES DE REFERÈNCIA
# --------------------------------------------
mitjana_edat <- mean(base_model$EDAT, na.rm = TRUE)
mitjana_any  <- mean(base_model$ANY,  na.rm = TRUE)

# --------------------------------------------
# 2) FUNCIÓ DE PREDICCIÓ MITJANA
#    Manté la resta de variables observades
# --------------------------------------------
pred_mitjana_edat_sexe <- function(model, data, resultat_nom) {
  
  res <- rbindlist(lapply(16:70, function(e) {
    rbindlist(lapply(c(0, 1), function(d) {
      tmp <- copy(data)
      
      tmp[, EDAT := e]
      tmp[, EDAT_c := EDAT - mitjana_edat]
      tmp[, EDAT_c2 := EDAT_c^2]
      tmp[, dona := d]
      
      p <- predict(model, newdata = tmp, type = "response")
      
      data.table(
        EDAT = e,
        dona = d,
        probabilitat = mean(p, na.rm = TRUE),
        resultat = resultat_nom
      )
    }))
  }))
  
  res[, sexe := fifelse(dona == 1, "Dones", "Homes")]
  return(res)
}

# --------------------------------------------
# 3) PREDICCIONS
# --------------------------------------------
pred_sobre <- pred_mitjana_edat_sexe(m_sobre_probit, base_model, "Sobrequalificació")
pred_infra <- pred_mitjana_edat_sexe(m_infra_probit, base_model, "Infraqualificació")

pred_plot <- rbindlist(list(pred_sobre, pred_infra))

# --------------------------------------------
# 4) GRÀFIC
# --------------------------------------------
g_pred_edat <- ggplot(
  pred_plot,
  aes(x = EDAT, y = probabilitat, linetype = sexe)
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  facet_wrap(~ resultat, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(round(100 * x, 0), "%")) +
  labs(
    title = "Probabilitats predides segons edat i sexe",
    subtitle = "Model probit sense pesos",
    x = "Edat",
    y = "Probabilitat predida",
    linetype = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

print(g_pred_edat)

ggsave(
  "prediccions_edat_sexe_probit.jpg",
  g_pred_edat,
  width = 10,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)
```

```{r}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)

setDT(base_model)

# --------------------------------------------
# 1) MITJANES USADES EN EL CENTRATGE
# --------------------------------------------
mitjana_edat <- mean(base_model$EDAT, na.rm = TRUE)
mitjana_any  <- mean(base_model$ANY,  na.rm = TRUE)

# --------------------------------------------
# 2) SI NO EXISTEIX PES REESCALAT, EL CREEM
# --------------------------------------------
if (!"pes_reesc" %in% names(base_model)) {
  base_model[, pes_reesc := FACTOREL / mean(FACTOREL, na.rm = TRUE)]
}

# --------------------------------------------
# 3) FUNCIONS AME
# --------------------------------------------
ame_binaria <- function(model, data, var, weights_var = NULL) {
  d0 <- copy(data)
  d1 <- copy(data)
  
  d0[, (var) := 0]
  d1[, (var) := 1]
  
  p0 <- predict(model, newdata = d0, type = "response")
  p1 <- predict(model, newdata = d1, type = "response")
  
  dif <- p1 - p0
  
  if (is.null(weights_var)) {
    return(mean(dif, na.rm = TRUE))
  } else {
    return(weighted.mean(dif, w = data[[weights_var]], na.rm = TRUE))
  }
}

ame_edat <- function(model, data, pas = 1, weights_var = NULL, mean_edat) {
  d0 <- copy(data)
  d1 <- copy(data)
  
  d1[, EDAT := EDAT + pas]
  d1[, EDAT_c := EDAT - mean_edat]
  d1[, EDAT_c2 := EDAT_c^2]
  
  p0 <- predict(model, newdata = d0, type = "response")
  p1 <- predict(model, newdata = d1, type = "response")
  
  dif <- (p1 - p0) / pas
  
  if (is.null(weights_var)) {
    return(mean(dif, na.rm = TRUE))
  } else {
    return(weighted.mean(dif, w = data[[weights_var]], na.rm = TRUE))
  }
}

ame_any <- function(model, data, pas = 1, weights_var = NULL, mean_any) {
  d0 <- copy(data)
  d1 <- copy(data)
  
  d1[, ANY := ANY + pas]
  d1[, ANY_c := ANY - mean_any]
  
  p0 <- predict(model, newdata = d0, type = "response")
  p1 <- predict(model, newdata = d1, type = "response")
  
  dif <- (p1 - p0) / pas
  
  if (is.null(weights_var)) {
    return(mean(dif, na.rm = TRUE))
  } else {
    return(weighted.mean(dif, w = data[[weights_var]], na.rm = TRUE))
  }
}

calcula_ame_model <- function(model, data, resultat, model_nom, weights_var = NULL,
                              mean_edat, mean_any) {
  
  data.table(
    resultat = resultat,
    model = model_nom,
    Variable = c("Dona", "Edat", "Any"),
    AME = c(
      ame_binaria(model, data, "dona", weights_var = weights_var),
      ame_edat(model, data, weights_var = weights_var, mean_edat = mean_edat),
      ame_any(model, data, weights_var = weights_var, mean_any = mean_any)
    )
  )
}

# --------------------------------------------
# 4) AME DELS TRES MODELS
# --------------------------------------------
robustesa_ame <- rbindlist(list(
  calcula_ame_model(m_sobre_probit,   base_model, "Sobrequalificació", "Probit",            NULL,        mitjana_edat, mitjana_any),
  calcula_ame_model(m_sobre_probit_w, base_model, "Sobrequalificació", "Probit amb pesos",  "pes_reesc", mitjana_edat, mitjana_any),
  calcula_ame_model(m_sobre_logit,    base_model, "Sobrequalificació", "Logit",             NULL,        mitjana_edat, mitjana_any),
  
  calcula_ame_model(m_infra_probit,   base_model, "Infraqualificació", "Probit",            NULL,        mitjana_edat, mitjana_any),
  calcula_ame_model(m_infra_probit_w, base_model, "Infraqualificació", "Probit amb pesos",  "pes_reesc", mitjana_edat, mitjana_any),
  calcula_ame_model(m_infra_logit,    base_model, "Infraqualificació", "Logit",             NULL,        mitjana_edat, mitjana_any)
))

print(robustesa_ame)
View(robustesa_ame)

# --------------------------------------------
# 5) GRÀFIC DE ROBUSTESA
# --------------------------------------------
g_robustesa <- ggplot(
  robustesa_ame,
  aes(x = AME, y = Variable, shape = model)
) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "gray60") +
  geom_point(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.5),
    size = 3
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ resultat, scales = "free_x") +

    title = "Comparació dels efectes marginals segons especificació",
    x = "Efecte marginal mitjà",
    y = NULL,
    shape = NULL

  "robustesa_ame_models.jpg",
```

```{r}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 1) FUNCIÓ PER EXTREURE COEFICIENTS DE LES CCAA
# --------------------------------------------------
extreu_coef_ccaa <- function(model, nom_model) {
  
  mat <- coef(summary(model))
  
  dt <- data.table(
    terme = rownames(mat),
    coef = mat[, 1],
    se = mat[, 2]
  )
  
  # només coeficients de CCAA
  dt <- dt[grepl("^CCAA_f", terme)]
  
  # intervals de confiança aproximats al 95%
  dt[, ic_low := coef - 1.96 * se]
  dt[, ic_high := coef + 1.96 * se]
  
  # extreure codi de CCAA
  dt[, CCAA := gsub("^CCAA_f", "", terme)]
  
  # model
  dt[, model := nom_model]
  
  dt[]
}

# --------------------------------------------------
# 2) EXTREURE RESULTATS DELS DOS MODELS
# --------------------------------------------------
coef_infra <- extreu_coef_ccaa(m_infra_probit, "Infraqualificació")
coef_sobre <- extreu_coef_ccaa(m_sobre_probit, "Sobrequalificació")

coef_ccaa <- rbindlist(list(coef_infra, coef_sobre), fill = TRUE)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 3) ETIQUETES DE CCAA
#    adapta-les si vols el nom complet
# --------------------------------------------------
labels_ccaa <- c(
  "01" = "Andalusia",
  "02" = "Aragó",
  "03" = "Astúries",
  "04" = "Illes Balears",
  "05" = "Canàries",
  "06" = "Cantàbria",
  "07" = "Castella i Lleó",
  "08" = "Castella-La Manxa",
  "09" = "Catalunya",
  "10" = "Comunitat Valenciana",
  "11" = "Extremadura",
  "12" = "Galícia",
  "13" = "Madrid",
  "14" = "Múrcia",
  "15" = "Navarra",
  "16" = "País Basc",
  "17" = "La Rioja",
  "18" = "Ceuta",
  "19" = "Melilla"
)

coef_ccaa[, CCAA_label := labels_ccaa[CCAA]]

# si alguna no queda etiquetada, mostrar el codi
coef_ccaa[is.na(CCAA_label), CCAA_label := CCAA]

# --------------------------------------------------
# 4) ORDENAR DINS DE CADA MODEL
# --------------------------------------------------
coef_ccaa[, CCAA_label := factor(CCAA_label, levels = unique(CCAA_label[order(coef)])), by = model]

# --------------------------------------------------
# 5) COEFPLOT
# --------------------------------------------------
g_ccaa <- ggplot(
  coef_ccaa,
  aes(x = coef, y = CCAA_label)
) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "gray60") +
  geom_errorbarh(
    aes(xmin = ic_low, xmax = ic_high),
    height = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~ model, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Coeficients estimats de les comunitats autònomes",
    subtitle = "Models probit sense pesos. Categoria de referència omesa",
    x = "Coeficient estimat",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

print(g_ccaa)

ggsave(
  "coefplot_ccaa_probit_sense_pesos.jpg",
  g_ccaa,
  width = 11,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 300
)
```
